acceptanceCriteria: A plan for a change adding only a docs/build-log entry reports no UNOWNED_DIRTY_PATH for it, and names the owning documentation checks or an explicit exclusion.
body:
Filed 2026-10-07 by the orchestrator session.

Observed 2026-10-07 in the batch 4 integration plan (base 0c27e35f, Core rc.2 build 360): every new docs/build-log/*.md entry (for example docs/build-log/2026-10-06-cem01-keeper-owner-exit.md) appears in plan.unknown as UNOWNED_DIRTY_PATH. Decision 0423 makes one new build-log file per entry the normal case, so every substantive change carries these unknowns and they add noise that hides real ones. Expected: build-log and decision records map to their declared owner (the documentation gates) or to an explicit non-code exclusion. Actual: an unknown per file. The over-broad selection itself (154 packages) is tracked separately by V1-0081.

completion.reason: Delivered on main 8def072e08e9730a6102657c887655f62993b31d via batch beamfall/corvint#1430 (lane #1420); CI green on that commit (runs 39631036070,39632775961). Owner 2026-10-21: CI-checked work needs no local full-gate. Evidence file sha256 f5b497b0919613a992b21983bc4eb968c7299b6a8636409ea4e5ff289819d16f.

title: affected: new docs/build-log and decision files are reported as UNOWNED_DIRTY_PATH unknowns
